title: Matrix bilinear form expansion
statement: Let $D$ be an $n\times n$ matrix over $\mathbb F_2$, and let $x,y\in\mathbb F_2^n$. The bilinear form $x\cdot(Dy)$ equals $\sum_{i=1}^n\sum_{j=1}^n D_{ij}x_i y_j$.
hypotheses_covered: $D$ is an $n\times n$ matrix over $\mathbb F_2$
